en.title: Japan Updates Disability Group Home Manager Qualifications to Improve Accessibility Standards
en.summary: Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare announced new qualification requirements for disability group home managers, mandating specific standards and staff training. Simultaneously, Saga Prefecture updated its disability welfare service guidelines, revising supervision, subsidies, and treatment improvement directives for providers. In other news, Disabled World marked its two‑decade history, and an accessibility app was highlighted for transforming Android phone usability for users with disabilities.

highlights.title: Japan introduces new qualification requirements for disability group home managers
Saga Prefecture updates disability welfare service guidelines
This accessibility app changed how I approach any Android phone - Android Police

zh-TW.title: 日本新增殘障團體之家管理者資格標準，提升無障礙服務品質
zh-TW.summary: 日本厚生勞動省宣布殘障團體之家管理者需符合新資格標準並接受強制員工培訓。同時，佐賀縣更新殘障福利服務指南，修訂營運監督、補助與治療改進方向。此外，Disabled World 紀念成立二十年，一則無障礙應用報導指出該應用顯著改善 Android 手機使用體驗，且社交媒體用戶讚賞江之島水族館的無障礙設施。

highlights.title: 日本新增殘障團體之家管理者資格要求
這款無障礙應用改變了我使用任何Android手機的方式 - Android Police
